message.content:
Line 5659 is in the ordered list item marks check:
```c
if(off > beg  &&
   (CH(off) == _T('.') || CH(off) == _T(')'))  &&
   (off+1 >= ctx->size || ISBLANK(off+1) || ISNEWLINE(off+1)))
```

The issue is that after the `while(off < max_end && ISDIGIT(off))` loop, `off` could equal `ctx->size` (if the digits run to the end of the buffer). Then `CH(off)` reads `ctx->text[off]` which is out of bounds. The check `off > beg` is true, but there's no check that `off < ctx->size` before accessing `CH(off)`.

Let me verify this is the exact line. Let me check line numbers.
